verdict.rationale: Asking a SaaS project-management product for a published uptime SLA and a public status page is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an SLA, uptime commitments, incident reporting, or a status page. The cited items cover the API, integrations, pricing features and MCP, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
